source.scope: Incremental tokens for aligning later high-fidelity Stitch / Figma pages to the revised homepage style.

typography.note: Figma homepage MCP uses optical tight tracking on some headings; project production token remains letterSpacing 0 to preserve protected terms such as iDMS and SaaS.

radius.usage: Default buttons and product containers use 8px / 16px. Homepage-derived tags may use 4px, compact logo marks may use 6px, and case/product cards may use 14px only when matching the MCP reference.

motion.homepageRhythm: Hero image fade, product screenshot stage overlap, dark-to-light section contrast, then stats band and CTA media mosaic.
motion.reducedMotion: use static poster and preserve all content

homepageMcpPatterns.hero: Dark cinematic restaurant / ordering scene, centered title, brand-blue second line, dual CTA, authorized logo cloud, product screenshot stage overlapping into next section.
homepageMcpPatterns.platformOverview: Dark gradient band, left narrative, right operational hub illustration, followed by deep product workbench or screenshot stage.
homepageMcpPatterns.caseSection: White editorial section with left conversion copy and right horizontal customer cards; use authorized names and real/approved visual assets only.
homepageMcpPatterns.statsBand: Dark photo-backed scale proof band with five authorized PPT Slide 11 metrics only.
homepageMcpPatterns.finalCta: White conversion section with left sales copy and right operational media mosaic.

stitchRules: Use the existing Stitch design system ID when available; do not restate colors or fonts in a generation prompt unless editing an existing screen for a hard issue.
Generate Traditional Chinese first pages and do not display bilingual body content.
每个剩余页面只允许一个目标 Stitch screen；首次只调用一次 generate_screen_from_text。
Only use edit_screens once on the same screen for hard issues: wrong page, missing core copy, internal notes, placeholder content, fake logos, unauthorized metrics, protected-term casing errors.
Do not copy unauthorized MCP details: simulated customer logo blocks, simplified Chinese labels, unverified percentages, fake platform badges, or stock-like claims.
Keep iDMS, SaaS, AMS / Connector exact casing. Do not use text-transform.
usageRules: 深色正文系统以 #16233d 的 95% / 65% / 45% 透明度表达层级。
官网首页及后续高保真页面必须保留暗色运营场景、产品工作台、客户证明、规模数据和 CTA 的节奏差异。
页面画布按 1440px 设计，实际内容宽度 1200px；首页 MCP 可使用 1280px 宽容器和 104px 边距。
默认圆角仍以 8px 和 16px 为主；仅在首页 MCP 对应标签、Logo mark、案例卡中使用 4px / 6px / 14px。
不得使用 text-transform 改写 iDMS、SaaS 或其他大小写敏感术语。
未在 PPT、旧官网、T27/T31 或用户确认中出现的指标、客户、Logo、产品截图、认证、SLA、平台接入状态不得写成正式事实。
